title: Hot Buttered Soul
hook: If you own 1 Isaac Hayes record, it's this.
voiceover: If you own 1 Isaac Hayes record, it's this. Hot Buttered Soul, Enterprise Records, a Stax label, 1969. 4 songs on the whole album. Walk On By runs 12 minutes and the guitar and strings in the first minute are under Biggie's Warning. Hyperbolicsyllabicsesquedalymistic is the piano and drums under Public Enemy's Black Steel in the Hour of Chaos. 2 of the biggest records of 2 decades off 1 album. What to look for. The bald head on the cover, the Enterprise label, and catalog number ENS-1001. Then check that side 2 plays clean, because By the Time I Get to Phoenix is 18 minutes and the last inch of a worn copy is trouble. Send this to the friend who still buys vinyl.
caption: Hot Buttered Soul, Isaac Hayes, Enterprise ENS-1001, 1969. Four songs. Walk On By is under Biggie's Warning, Hyperbolicsyllabicsesquedalymistic is under Public Enemy's Black Steel in the Hour of Chaos, and that's before you get to the 18 minute Phoenix on side 2. The record that proved soul albums could be long. What's the record you'd never sell? 🎙️
